title: Resource latency by type (ms)
sqlTemplate: select resource_type, approx_percentile_cont(resource_duration, 0.5) / 1000000.0 as p50, approx_percentile_cont(resource_duration, 0.95) / 1000000.0 as p95, count(*) as sample_count from _rumdata where service = {{service}} and env = {{environment}}{{version_clause}} and type = 'resource' group by resource_type order by p95 desc limit 20
emptyDataSemantics: No matching resource records -> an empty result set (zero rows); p50/p95 are only ever NULL as part of an absent row, never a present row with NULL percentiles.
